content.short: Francium is a DeFi yield-strategy platform offering leveraged farming and on-chain trading strategies.
content.description: Francium is one of Solana's largest DeFi platforms for yield generation and operates across Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and OP Mainnet. It goes beyond traditional lending and borrowing by offering profit-generating yield strategies tailored to individual needs, helping identify high-yield assets and efficiently channel funds to those opportunities. The platform also connects developers and users in a decentralized way, enabling creators to build products that users find useful.
